item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. We believe this plainly, and we’re committed to making sure people stay in charge of the systems we build.

2. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will remain fully under human control. We can shape how these systems are developed and governed—and keep human decisions at the center.

3. We believe superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will remain fully under human control. The future is ours to shape, and we will ensure people—not machines—make the decisions that matter.

**(b) Newsletter opening (106 words)**

We believe superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will remain fully under human control. This is not a distant abstraction; it is a future we can shape through the choices we make now. We are working toward a world where people set the goals, establish the limits, and make the decisions that matter. Keeping AI under human control means treating human judgment and accountability as essential at every stage of development and use. It means building institutions and practices that keep people in charge. We are confident that superintelligent AI will remain a tool directed by humanity, and we will keep working to make that future real.
